title: RepositoryAssessmentV1
description: Versioned repository assessment produced by ARM Migration Assist Feature 1 (Repository Analysis) and consumed by the AI Migration Planner (Feature 2). Cross-record rules that JSON Schema cannot express (unique evidence IDs, evidence-reference resolution, filesScanned <= filesTotal) are enforced by the evidence validator. Format assertions (date-time, uri) must be explicitly enabled in the JSON Schema validator; the .NET planner enables strict format validation.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version tag. Accepts 1.x minor versions. Unsupported majors are rejected with a 409 Problem Details response.

assessmentId.description: Stable identifier for this assessment run. Referenced by the planner output and audit log.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the assessment was produced.

producer.description: Metadata about the scanners that produced this assessment. Recorded in the audit log so plans are reproducible.

commitSha.description: Full Git commit SHA the assessment was produced against. SHA-1 (40 hex) or SHA-256 (64 hex).

defaultBranch.description: Default branch name at assessment time.

license.description: SPDX license identifier, free-form label, or null when unknown.

languages.description: Programming languages detected in the repository.

dependencies.description: Dependency inventory with ARM64 compatibility signals.

codeFindings.description: Architecture-specific code patterns detected by scanners.

buildFindings.description: Build system and CI readiness signals.

scanCoverage.description: Scanner completeness so incomplete results can be marked provisional.

unknowns.description: Explicit unresolved questions the assessment could not answer.

availableSkills.description: Reusable agents and skills the planner may cite in workItems. The planner must reference only skills listed here or declare gaps in missingSkills.

EvidenceId.$comment: Cross-record uniqueness is enforced by the evidence validator, not by JSON Schema.

Confidence.description: Analyst confidence in the finding on a 0.0 to 1.0 scale. Aggregate readiness confidence lives in ReadinessScoreV1.

ruleset.description: Ruleset or rule-catalog identifier used by the scanners, or null.

scannerVersions.description: Per-scanner semantic versions used to produce this assessment.

Evidence.description: A concrete piece of evidence supporting a finding. References exactly one source (file path or non-file artifact) and includes a concise, factual observation. No inferences or recommendations belong here.

sourceType.description: Kind of source the evidence was drawn from.

path.description: Repository-relative path when the evidence is a file, manifest, or config.

artifact.description: Artifact identifier when the evidence is not a source-tree file (e.g. a build output name or dependency graph node).

observation.description: Concise, factual observation the scanner recorded from the source.

DependencyFinding.description: One dependency and its ARM64 compatibility signals.

name.description: Package or component name as declared by the ecosystem.

version.description: Declared version string, or null when not resolvable.

type.description: Dependency kind. Drives the scoring model and blocker caps.

criticality.description: Whether the dependency is required for the primary application path or optional.

availableArchitectures.description: Architectures the dependency is known to be published for.

CodeFinding.description: One architecture-specific code pattern detected in source.

ruleId.description: Stable rule identifier from the scanner (e.g. 'ARM-CODE-SIMD-01').

file.description: Repository-relative file path where the finding was observed.

line.description: 1-based line number, or null when the finding is file-scoped.

column.description: 1-based column number, or null when unavailable.

description.description: Short, human-readable description of the pattern.

BuildFindings.description: Build system and CI readiness signals aggregated across the repository.

arm64TargetExists.description: Whether at least one build target produces native ARM64 binaries.

arm64EcTargetExists.description: Whether at least one build target produces Arm64EC binaries.

arm64CiJobExists.description: Whether CI configuration includes an ARM64 or Arm64EC job.

packagingSupportsArm64.description: Whether installer or packaging configuration produces an ARM64 artifact.

testsExist.description: Whether any automated test suite exists in the repository.

detectedTargets.description: Build targets or platforms detected in project files or CI (e.g. 'x64/Debug', 'ARM64/Release').

WindowsExperience.description: Signals about how Windows-native the application currently is.

windowsVersionExists.description: Whether the application already ships a Windows build.

uiTechnology.description: Detected UI stack. Use 'other' when a known stack falls outside the enum; use 'unknown' when detection failed.

installerExists.description: Whether the repository produces a Windows installer or package.

offlineCapable.description: Whether the application supports meaningful offline usage.

accessibilityEvidence.description: Accessibility signal classification. 'none' = no accessibility affordances detected; 'partial' = some affordances; 'full' = comprehensive coverage; 'unknown' = not assessed.

accessibilityNotes.description: Optional free-form notes describing the specific accessibility signals detected.

notificationsIntegrated.description: Whether the application integrates with Windows notifications.

lifecycleIntegrated.description: Whether the application integrates with Windows app lifecycle events (suspend, resume, background).

ScanCoverage.$comment: filesScanned <= filesTotal is enforced by the evidence validator.
ScanCoverage.description: Scanner completeness. Insufficient coverage marks the plan as provisional.

dependencyResolutionRate.description: Fraction of declared dependencies whose ARM64 status could be classified (0.0 to 1.0).

scannersCompleted.description: Scanner identifiers that ran to completion.

scannersFailed.description: Scanner identifiers that failed or timed out.

Unknown.description: An explicit unresolved question the assessment could not answer. The planner surfaces these rather than guessing.

description.description: Concise description of the unresolved question.

area.description: Which part of the assessment the unknown belongs to.

requiredSkill.description: Suggested skill name that could resolve this unknown, or null.

evidenceIds.description: Optional links to related evidence records.

Skill.description: A reusable agent or skill available to the planner. Write-capable skills always require approval before execution.

name.description: Kebab-case skill identifier, optionally namespaced with '/' (e.g. 'assessment/repository-discovery').

description.description: Short description of what the skill accepts and produces.

writeAccess.description: true if this skill can modify a repository or execute non-read operations. Write-capable skills always require approval.
